answer_2.quote: We use attack success rate (ASR) as the evaluation metric. ... We use ASR-H and ASR-A ... and ASR-P for privacy leakage.

answer_3.quote: We utilize an outside LLM to determine whether a response is harmful. In particular, we use Marcoroni-7B ... If the response from the outside LLM contains "Yes", the response ... is determined to be harmful.

answer_4.quote: We take human evaluation in Appendix B.2 to compare the harmfulness of responses as a supportive experiment. We first recruit 8 human evaluators ... we asked the evaluator to pick the most harmful response to each question according to their common sense.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were asked to select the most harmful response for each prompt based on common sense.
